title: Copy tensor views with explicit storage ownership
goal: Preserve logical grid values when tensor views share storage by choosing snapshots or independent output.

selectionNotes: Preserve logical grid values when tensor views share storage by choosing snapshots or independent output.
Verified with GA SDK/runtime and System.Numerics.Tensors11.0.0 on Windows x64. Other platforms and execution engines remain unverified.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Canonical full-release target is .NET 11; this recipe does not establish a newer-package-on-net10 route.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Use the .NET 11 SDK for the net11.0/C#15 consumer; exact tested pins are evidence baselines.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical current sample mode; the policy code requires no experimental syntax.

packages.name: System.Numerics.Tensors
packages.reason: The shipped .NET 11 package contains the release/11.0 storage and shape backport; verified with package11.0.0.

packageAssets: Canonical route: lib/net11.0/System.Numerics.Tensors.dll from package11.0.0; previous policy uses10.0.13/lib/net10.0.
platforms: Measured Windows x64 CoreCLR JIT execution. Other platforms, Native AOT and Mono are not tested.
prerequisites: SDK console project, ImplicitUsings and Nullable enabled, using System.Numerics.Tensors and namespace Playbook.Samples; select final System.Numerics.Tensors11 containing backport #135281.
Allocate independent output or explicitly snapshot each overlapping input before writing; repeated output locations require independently addressable storage.
constraints: Supported overlap is operation-specific: dense/equal-count or identical copies; dense flatten/resize; identical nonrepeating elementwise views; dense or no-op in-place reversal. Try copying false handles capacity/shape, not layout exceptions.

Repeated zero-stride outputs are invalid for ResizeTo and destination concatenation; singleton and empty outputs remain permitted. Both Array constructor forms reject incompatible types, writable covariance is rejected, read-only compatible covariance is allowed.
stabilityLimitations: No experimental annotation or opt-in on the selected GA types. Execution proof is limited to the declared consumers and measured Windows x64 platform; global stable readiness remains PIN-967.

evidence.scope: Actual SDK10.0.403/runtime10.0.14/locked tensor10.0.13 net10 execution: original grid snapshots, independent output, both-input snapshots, intended logical values and Try capacity/shape false without writes. No new storage contract claimed.

Actual SDK11.0.100/runtime11.0.0 and locked tensor11.0.0 net11 execution: complete storage suite, copy/flatten wrappers, overlap rejection before writes, allowed dense/identical copies, elementwise/resize/reversal, zero-stride outputs and Array/covariance controls.
